# My sketches using p5js — CostardRouge

> Steeve Pommier's generative-art sketches written with p5.js between 2021 and 2025, published as a gallery where each sketch runs live in the browser.

The gallery lists 453 sketches in 45 groups, newest groups first. Each sketch page runs its code full screen in the browser — some react to sound, a camera or a MIDI instrument — and its source code is on GitHub under the MIT licence.

## The site

- [Gallery](https://art.steeve.website/): every group and sketch, a tile per sketch
- [Source code](https://github.com/CostardRouge/generative-art-p5js): the sketches, their runtime in utils/ and the gallery's build
- [Legal notice](https://art.steeve.website/legal/): publisher, host, what is measured and kept
